actual_driver_config.queue_measurement: Enqueue-to-Dequeue wait; includes zero, excludes serialization and propagation; censored packets in queue_pending.csv
actual_driver_config.topology: two nodes, one full-duplex point-to-point link

driver_validation.qualification: Matched-window app rate uses full window width; active-interval rate separately excludes time before that flow starts. Whole-run rates and whole-life rates differ for the late competitor.

drop_coverage.qualification: Per-hook records are preserved. TcDrop and per-device root_queue_disc_absent are required in addition to queue/device/IP drops before asserting complete modeled network-drop coverage.

independent_layer_drop_audit.qualification: Layer rows may duplicate one physical loss. Distinct tx_id is counted within flow and layer. Queue DropBeforeEnqueue=0 does not imply network loss=0: TrafficControl TcDrop can occur before a full device queue accepts the packet. Device4294967295 is the TcDrop hook's unknown-device sentinel, not a physical device index.

method.application: Positive receiver HandleRead payload, per-connection cumulative sum checked. Connection key includes local port to distinguish two sinks each numbered connection0. Flow1 app goodput measures actual competitor delivery, not offered/sender-ACKed bytes.
method.loss_recovery: Official RETX rows and bytes; CA_RECOVERY and CA_LOSS entries are separately counted. LOSS is not automatically an RTO. Drop layer rows may duplicate a physical loss, so distinct (flow,tx_id) counts are separate; untagged drops remain explicit.
method.scope: Fixed propagation plus persistent queue is a falsification control for recent-min renewal. Increased foreground delivery alone does not establish total service improvement or fairness; examine competitor app, queue delay, drops, and terminal gap. A synthetic delay step is distinct from the multi-hop LEO model.
method.terminal: Wire payload interval union minus actual app delivery at stop time; wire Rx is pre-TCP and does not prove acceptance or eventual delivery. Sequence unwrapping assumes adjacent references differ by less than2^31 bytes.
method.windows: Exact half-open [start_ns,end_ns) on each observation's timestamp; event-time delivery belongs to post-event interval. Whole includes startup; late20/pre20/post(+10,+30) are matched between cases.

original_study_analysis_check.qualification: Independent raw app sums checked against supplied full analysis. Analysis source hash is separately recorded; full original JSON is not duplicated.

coverage.qualification: Per-hook records are preserved. TcDrop and per-device root_queue_disc_absent are required in addition to queue/device/IP drops before asserting complete modeled network-drop coverage.

queue_instrumentation.qualification: Sojourn is exact Enqueue-to-Dequeue waiting time, including zero waits, grouped by dequeue timestamps; excludes link serialization/propagation. Remove/DropAfterDequeue rows are excluded. Quantiles use packet counts (nearest rank), not byte or time weighting. Untagged ACK/control traffic is not assigned to a TCP flow. Occupancy holds the post-change snapshot between trace rows.

vegas_internal_state.qualification: Actual internal state trace. Instance IDs are retained; the driver must establish that flow0 alone uses Vegas. Histories are cycle based; history_elapsed_ns is recorded rather than assumed equal to a fixed number of RTTs.

0.qualification: Smoothed sender RTT held between trace changes; excludes initial unknown/zero SRTT; not raw packet RTT or isolated queueing delay.

1.qualification: Smoothed sender RTT held between trace changes; excludes initial unknown/zero SRTT; not raw packet RTT or isolated queueing delay.
